title: Modern Architecture: Glass & Concrete
description: Generate stunning modern architectural visualizations in MJ v6.1. From Zaha Hadid to Tadao Ando styles.

prompt.main: architectural visualization of a modern minimalist villa at dusk, cantilevered concrete and glass facade, infinity pool reflecting sunset, surrounded by pine forest, warm interior lighting visible through floor-to-ceiling windows, zaha hadid style, architectural digest cover quality, blue hour, dramatic up-lighting, 8k photoreal --v 6.1 --ar 16:9 --s 600

explained.why: Medium stylize 鈥?high enough to compose drama, low enough to feel real.
Architect anchor 鈥?tells MJ this is high-end design, not generic.

tutorial.intro: Architectural visualization is 80% lighting and 20% material. The AI is great at both if you cue them.
steps: Building: cantilevered concrete and glass facade 鈥?specific modernist details.
Setting: surrounded by pine forest, infinity pool reflecting sunset 鈥?gives the building context.
Lighting (exterior): blue hour, dramatic up-lighting 鈥?architecture's signature time.
Lighting (interior): warm interior lighting visible through floor-to-ceiling windows 鈥?sells the "lived in" feel.
Style anchor: zaha hadid style, architectural digest cover quality 鈥?locks to high-end design photography.
tutorial.tips: Architectural Digest quality comes from "blue hour" + "warm interior light" + "dramatic up-lighting". All three together = the "expensive building" look.

faq.q: Why does my building look generic?
faq.a: You forgot the architect anchor. "Zaha Hadid" / "Tadao Ando" / "Bjarke Ingels" instantly upgrades the style.
Blue hour (just after sunset) 鈥?sky is blue, building lights are warm, contrast is gorgeous.

faq.q: How to add people for scale?
faq.a: Actually avoid people for clean shots. Use "no people" in negative to prevent AI from adding random figures.
